databaseChecks.how: SQLite integrity_check and foreign_key_check run after launch and weekly while open. The last attempt is held for this launch.

health.title: Source health and freshness
health.source: Source: the app's own fetch and load records
health.how: A source's last good read is its latest load without an error; a failure is shown while it is newer than that. A source is lost when it has failed and had no good load within its window. The board runs reduced when a measure it reads has no source flowing; it is rebalanced only when you approve it. Board use is noted only for sources supplying board measures; other rows are reference or linking inputs.

signals.title: Signal files
signals.how: A file is fresh while its last load is within its source's window. Players with data are counted in the latest season holding any; waiting ids are source players not yet matched to an MFL player. Rostered players with data covers every position the league rosters.

facts.title: Checked facts
facts.note: No manifest yet: import the league archive under Data refresh to pin the Lab's inputs.
facts.source: Source: the league archive in history.db
facts.how: The checked facts are compiled from exactly the archived MFL files a manifest pins, by their bytes' sha256, never from the newest copy of a file. Only the five exact frozen login-error pins have named non-data gaps; other missing bytes block compilation. A fresh download never stands in for a pin.

checks.title: Checks
checks.note: Not run yet: the checks run when the facts compile, after the league archive is imported.
checks.source: Source: the compiled facts and MFL's own figures
checks.how: Each check compares two records MFL keeps separately. Every difference must be named, by its identity, in the pinned list of explained and reviewed differences; a new one fails the compile, and the last good snapshot is kept, marked stale.
